meta.title: {organizer} invited you to {group}
meta.generic-title: You're invited to a Secret Santa
meta.description: Join the Secret Santa on Givto: add your wishlist and find out who you're buying for.

unavailable.title: This link doesn't work anymore
unavailable.link: The organizer may have made a new link. Ask them to share it again.
unavailable.invite: This invite was already used, declined or has expired. Ask your organizer for a new one.

intro.title: {organizer} invited you to {group}
intro.description: Join the Secret Santa: add your wishlist and find out who you're buying for.
intro.approval: The organizer lets people in, so you'll be in once they've said yes.

requested.title: Almost there!
requested.description: {organizer} still has to let you in. We'll show the Secret Santa in your list as soon as they do.

details.name: Your name
details.name-help: Everyone in the Secret Santa sees this name.
details.email-help: We'll send you a code to check it's you.

code.sent: We sent a 6-digit code and a sign-in link to {email}. Enter the code, or click the link in the email.
code.label: Code
code.help: It works once and expires in 10 minutes.

errors.rate-limited: That's a lot of codes. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.code-wrong: That code isn't right. Check the email and try again.
errors.code-expired: That code has expired. Send yourself a new one.
errors.code-attempts: Too many tries. Send yourself a new code.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

errors.GROUP_FULL: This Secret Santa is full. Ask the organizer to make room.
errors.JOIN_LINK_INVALID: This link doesn't work anymore. Ask the organizer for the new one.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: That's a lot of tries. Wait a bit and try again.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Something doesn't look right. Check your name and try again.
errors.INVITE_INVALID: This invite was already used or has expired.
errors.INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH: This invite is for another email address.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

invite.other-account: This invite is for {email}, but you're signed in as {signedInEmail}. Sign out to continue.
invite.declined: {organizer} will see that you're sitting this one out.
